column1: # Partition table for G3 TC bringup shell with OTA support
# Board: Freenove ESP32-S3 WROOM (8 MB flash)
# ota_0 / ota_1 = OTA alternating slots (2 MB each
# dut_fw  = PFW test stub (15 KB; UART command handler for functional test)
# prod_fw = Sensit combined bootloader+app image (536 KB as of G3_01_00_46_FACT.bin)
# recipes = LittleFS partition for JSON recipe storage (~80 recipes @ 4 KB avg)
#   prod_fw sized for Sensit's full BLE+GPS+display+sensor stack (536 KB current
#   includes STM32 bootloader at 0x08000000 + app at 0x08008000).
#   896 KB gives 360 KB headroom for firmware growth.
#   dut_fw only holds 15 KB PFW test stub; 640 KB is 42x current size.
